title: A Generalized Langevin Model of Latent Liquidity and Concave Price Impact
abstract: arXiv:2609.37872v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We model market impact as the response to submitted order flow net of counterflow from latent traders, activated when price displacements from the level that would prevail without the order exceed individual thresholds. Order flow depletes this pool, and a generalized Langevin equation governs its recovery over several time scales. Its memory kernels are finite sums of exponentials, so its Markovian lift is exact rather than an approximation. For an undepleted pool, aggregation under explicit assumptions on individual trading responses yields an intermediate square-root regime between linear small- and large-order limits, without imposing a square-root impact law. Scaling thresholds and responses with price noise makes impact in this regime proportional to volatility, and thresholds that grow with the execution horizon make it independent of duration. translated_title: 潜在流动性与凹形价格冲击的广义朗之万模型
translated_abstract: 我们将市场冲击建模为对提交订单流的响应，并扣除来自潜在交易者的逆向流；当价格偏离无该订单时应有的水平并超过各自阈值时，这些潜在交易者被激活。订单流会耗尽这一潜在流动性池，而一个广义朗之万方程控制着该池在多个时间尺度上的恢复过程。其记忆核为有限个指数函数之和，因此其马尔可夫提升是精确的而非近似的。在流动性池未被耗尽的情形下，在关于个体交易响应的明确假设下进行加总，得到了介于线性小额订单极限与线性大额订单极限之间的中间平方根区域，而无需强行施加平方根冲击定律。使阈值和响应随价格噪声进行标度，使得该区域中的冲击与波动率成正比；随执行期限增长的阈值则使冲击与执行时长无关。在显示深度恒定的条件下，预期往返交易成本在对数……（原文摘要在此处截断）下为非负。
tldr: 该论文提出一个基于广义朗之万方程的潜在流动性模型，其记忆核为有限指数和从而实现精确的马尔可夫提升，无需强加平方根冲击定律即可从个体交易响应的加总中自然导出平方根冲击区域，并证明冲击与波动率成正比且与执行时长无关。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generalized Langevin model of latent liquidity whose memory kernels are finite sums of exponentials, enabling an exact Markovian lift and deriving the square-root impact regime naturally from aggregation of individual trading responses, with impact proportional to volatility and independent of execution duration.
